main_text.p: dit. Arcem S. Angeli ingenti impensa munitissimā reddidit. Templum Mariæ maioris incredibili pulchritudine exornauit. Vias publicas Leonina[?] ur-bis constrauit, aliaq; in urbe ædificia instauravit: sed de cælesti Hierusalem nihil cogitauit. Plures animi dotes, inquit Volaterranus, magnis obrue-rat vitijs, quæ narrare non attinet: tantum referā quæ vulgus aspexit. Si quando rerum fisce, ait, nō premeretur, omni remissionis generi (sanctus Pon-tifex) sine discrimine se dedidit. Quapropter co-mœdias Plautinas, cæteraq; ludicra (Papale exer-citium) libenter spectauit. Frequenterq; in Hadria-ni molem ventitabat, ut palam personatos per eo-rum ferias atq; omnes dies festos, si quid elegantius in hominum genere, scortis vel Ganymedibus, per viam præteriret, propius aspiceret. In nuptijs filiæ quæ ad virum Ferrariam erat profectura, eque-stres ludos & venationes in Vaticano extra ordi-nem dedit. In urbe gladiatorum nunquam licentia maior, nunquam populo Romano libertas minor.

Delatorum magna frequentia, breuissimo male-dicto pœna mortis erat. Grassatorum insuper omnia plena: nec noctu tutum per urbem iter, nec in-terdiu extra urbem. Roma gentium refugium & arx populorum omnibus seculis, nobilis iam car-nifficima[?] facta erat. Quæ quidem omnia, furiorū[?]

page.notes: No margin notes, headings or footnotes printed on this page. Doubtful readings: "Leonina" (could be Leoninæ); "nifficima" after "car-" (the printed word is hard to read, probably carnificissima); "furiorū" at the line end (the first letter is unclear, read as a long s or f); signature "f 5" (the f is uncertain). "pul-chritudine" was joined without a hyphen because no printed hyphen is visible at the line end. The paragraph break before "Delatorum" is inferred from the indent and not certain. The text at the start is a fragment ("dit.") continuing from the previous page. Show-through from the reverse side is ignored.
